title: SentinelVisionIncidentRecord
description: Structured incident record emitted when an unauthorized person enters a restricted zone

incident_id.description: Unique identifier for the safety incident event

timestamp_iso.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of incident detection

frame_index.description: Video frame index where the incident occurred, if available

event_type.description: Classification of the zone intrusion event

zone_id.description: Identifier of the restricted zone breached

zone_name.description: Human-readable label of the restricted zone

track_id.description: Unique tracking identifier of the person from the tracker component (null if unassigned)

confidence.description: Detection confidence score from the perception model

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in normalized [0, 1] space

ground_contact_point.description: Calculated ground contact point [x, y] representing person footprint
